jobs.title: Policy Fellow Klimamigration (m/w/d)
jobs.reason: The posting requires at least five years of relevant experience ("Mindestens fünf Jahre einschlägige Arbeitserfahrung werden vorausgesetzt") plus an established policy network and fundraising track record — well beyond the candidate's student-assistant background, a hard disqualifier. Although DGAP and the climate/foreign-policy security angle sit in a genuinely interesting zone, the seniority is an unmet essential.

jobs.reason: This is a Studentische Hilfskraft (working-student) role, which is excluded as a matter of policy regardless of fit. It also requires current enrolment in a literature/art/culture programme and cultural-management experience, which sit outside the candidate's profile.

jobs.title: Praktikum in den Literatur- und Oralturpraktiken für die Reihe Middle Ground (m/w/d/k)

jobs.title: technische Produktionsassistenz Berlinale (m/w/d/k)
jobs.reason: Requires a completed degree in event/culture management plus several years of professional experience in event safety and technical production planning, along with specialist knowledge of fire safety, occupational safety and procurement law — none of which the candidate has. This is a technical events-management role well outside all three interest zones and fails on both level and essential skills.

jobs.title: Oman Research Grant 2027
jobs.reason: The posting gives little detail, but as a research grant it is likely an eligible early-career funding opportunity rather than a role requiring a completed PhD. However, a research focus on Oman / regional area studies sits well outside the candidate's core zones (international law, atrocity prevention, European security) and may implicitly favour regional-language or thematic specialists, keeping interest and fit modest.

jobs.title: Doctoral Program — European Wasatia Graduate School for Peace and Conflict Resolution
jobs.organisation: Europa-Universität Flensburg (via Leibniz-Zentrum Moderner Orient listing)
jobs.reason: A doctoral program in peace and conflict resolution is entry-level by definition and squarely on-target for the candidate's interests in post-atrocity reconciliation and international justice; the MSc satisfies the entry requirement. Funding is not stated, so it is treated as eligible, but the explicit orientation toward Middle East/West Asia candidates and possible regional-language expectations, plus uncertainty over a stipend, temper the score.
